items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially is active today vs. the Raiders despite calf injury that limited practice.
items.why: Officially active after optimism reports and feeling better Saturday; no setbacks.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected; start with confidence in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Primary WR target share with Adams already out long-term.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall inactive today; was GTD/pessimistic after limited practice returning from quad.
items.why: Officially inactive; sources said unlikely, early in return, not full participant.
items.implication: Sit; handcuff/backup elevates significantly in good matchup.
items.opportunity: Lead back role fully available to committee mate.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson OUT (ankle); third straight miss. Huntley starts again.
items.why: Downgraded/ruled out Saturday after limited practice.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; pivot to streaming QBs or Huntley in deeper formats. Ravens pass game muted.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and short-area targets elevate slightly.

items.text: ETR Sun AM summary: Puka GTD/OPT, Breece GTD/PESS, Saquon expected, Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson IN, Lamar/DeVonta/Wicks OUT, Mike Washington GTD.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for fantasy decisions pre-inactives.
items.implication: Update lineups/projections immediately; direct role changes.
items.opportunity: Implied for INs and OUT beneficiaries (e.g. PHI pass game, Jets backfield).

items.text: Think Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; he produced 124/17/1 as lead back then felt something late.
items.why: Levitan gut on post-game feel; player admitted felt something, slid to protect; bye week helps.
items.implication: Monitor closely for Week 9; usage was excellent as lead but durability flag.
items.opportunity: Proven lead-back snaps/carries/goal-line when healthy; Tracy also hamstring.
items.conflict: Produced big game; Rapoport confirmed lead role and stats.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if injured avoiding TD.
items.implication: No major concern for next week; monitor reports.

items.text: Late injury watch: CMC (quad) returned to game; Kenny Gainwell (hip) returned; also watching Waddle shoulder, Aaron Jones knee, others.
items.implication: CMC/Gainwell likely OK short-term; Waddle etc. for next week.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected/resumed lead back role; final 124 yards on 17 carries + TD.
items.why: Sources pre-game; confirmed by box score.
items.implication: Clear lead when healthy; strong ROS signal despite late scare.
items.opportunity: High carry share, YPC, TD upside; two-minute/OT usage.

items.text: All ETR projections fully updated to latest statuses (Lamar/Puka/Breece crucial); Gibbs almost certainly fine.
items.why: Reflects morning injury summary and news.
items.implication: Use latest for start/sit/DFS; player-specific adjustments key.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT.
items.why: Weekend reports confirmed OUT for both.
items.implication: Avoid; remaining PHI pass catchers see target bump vs DAL on MNF.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Goedert and any active WRs; Saquon if active benefits from scheme.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (MNF vs DAL) after hamstring.
items.why: Weekend reports optimistic/in line to play.
items.implication: Plan to start if confirmed active; efficient when healthy.
items.opportunity: Featured back role; PHI depleted at WR boosts checkdowns/carries.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected/IN to play after layoff.
items.why: Activated; listed among players expected to play.
items.implication: Startable but monitor workload post-layoff; volume RB upside.
items.conflict: Some analysts wary of rust (Berry notes post-layoff).

items.text: Panthers OT Taylor Moton suffered fractured fibula, out indefinitely (second game back from blood clot).
items.why: Fractured fibula in loss to TB; coach confirmed.
items.implication: CAR OL further depleted; impacts run/pass protection long-term, possible fantasy ripple for skill players.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown for usage and matchup (WR10 range).
Loves Tucker Kraft vs DET TE buffet (multiple TEs hitting big vs Lions).
items.opportunity: Red-zone and volume upside vs vulnerable D.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving; Saquon if active.
items.why: Volume/opportunity focus; Saquon efficiency when healthy.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (shadow coverage) and Josh Downs.
items.why: Odunze outside routes vs Gonzalez shadow; limited upside spots for Downs.
